name: kubernetes-deploy
description: Create Kubernetes manifests for application deployment
request_pattern: Create Kubernetes deployment manifests for ${app_name}. Include: Deployment with ${replicas} replicas, Service (ClusterIP + LoadBalancer), ConfigMap, Secret (template), HPA for autoscaling, PodDisruptionBudget, health/readiness probes, resource limits, and a Kustomize base. Target namespace: ${namespace}.
